assign.outcome:
**The site's button now takes the grammar.** `styles/layers/theme/lew42/lew42.css`'s `.theme-lew42 :is(button, .btn)` rule — `font-size: 0.8em; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.7em 1.4em; border-radius: var(--radius)` — is deleted. None of the six was kept as a brand voice: font-size and padding directly fought the owner's own ask ("match each other, and match the base font size"); text-transform was named to go; border-radius was already identical to the grammar's own value, so it was inert either way; font-weight and letter-spacing were paired with the uppercase to form one shouty-CTA look, not flagged anywhere as a standalone mark the way `--prim`'s orange is. A one-paragraph comment stands in the rule's place explaining why nothing lives there now.

**[Controls](/framework/ui/controls/)** — the two rows are one row. Before: button/prim/bg/`a.btn` measured **36.89px** at 1280 against the grammar's 36.09; **43.77px** at 3440 against 43.19. After: all four are **36.09px** at 1280 and **43.19px** at 3440, at every step of the size ladder (27.06/45.11 and 32.39/54).

**Homepage, before/after at 1280** (screenshots in this dir): the live-demo corner toggle (`demo-btn`) visibly changes from an uppercase bold pill with 7.16/14.32px padding to a plain button with 2.30/5.75px padding.

![before](home-before-1280.png) ![after](home-after-1280.png)

**What is NOT 36.09px on `/`, `/framework/`, `/imagine/paging/`, `/blog/` — and why, per the brief.** Not one bare `<button>` exists on these four pages: every one is a component with its own class restating font-size/padding at higher specificity than the plain rule, so this edit cannot and does not reach them — `dev-x`/`dev-size` (fixed-px dev-toolbar chrome, every page), `sidebar-toggle` (`/`, `/framework/`, `/blog/`), `mode-btn` (the dark/light toggle), `demo-btn` incl. `demo-scrub` (`/`), `panel-btn` (`/framework/`), and the `.prim`/unclassed "Get started"/"Read the docs" pair on `/imagine/paging/` (a `styles/sections/hero.js` demo preview embedded there, scaled small by its own CSS, not a real page CTA). This matches ui-theme's own "accidental button families" finding — collapsing those nine is a separate task, not this one's fence.

**Verified:** zero console errors on all four pages at 400/1280/3440, and on `/framework/ui/controls/` at 400/1280/3440.

**Left, on purpose.** `/framework/ui/controls/doc/grammar.md`'s "What the skin still does" section now describes a rule that no longer exists — outside my write fence (theme file's declarations + this task dir only), so it's a one-line note for whoever next opens `ui/controls/`, not a fix I made.
